name: G
note: Attempt G = F resumed, with one change, approved by the user: a fairer boulder. Its top now stays at least 3.5 m below the start (centre 3 m above the pad up to 6.5 m minus its radius; it was up to 7 m). Before, about 2% of flights put the rock right under the start and looked unavoidable (a crude escape still hit 2.1%; now 0.65%). Lower boulders crowd the pad more: the pilot lands 71.7% on the new layout. All real-task numbers from here on are on the new layout.

stages.name: boulder, calm air
stages.expect: The pilot lands 95.6% here. The copy should get there; selection now sees the boulder in every flight.

stages.name: boulder, gusts
stages.expect: Steering around the boulder while gusts push sideways. Pass at 93%.

stages.name: everything
stages.expect: The full final world. Start level with the pilot (~71-77%); aim to pass it.

stages.name: polish
stages.expect: Everything on, only the env score + landing bonus. Pass = 98% on 100 + 100 fresh flights, then the 1,000-flight goal check.
